use_when: Designing a coherent UI screen set
pitfalls: Do not imply working functionality or expose PII
text_policy: Use placeholder or externally layered copy

use_when: Explaining a process, concept, or metric visually
pitfalls: Do not force dense labels or unsupported metrics
text_policy: Keep labels short; layer final copy externally

use_when: Showing scale, comparison, or scientific phenomena
pitfalls: Do not invent measurements or distort relative scale
text_policy: Use only verified short labels

use_when: Creating a campaign, event, or announcement poster
pitfalls: Do not rely on generated long copy or absent legal details
text_policy: Reserve text zones; typeset final copy externally

use_when: Creating energetic sports or fitness campaign visuals
pitfalls: Avoid unlicensed team marks and misleading endorsements
text_policy: Use supplied names and final copy only

use_when: Making a type-led editorial or campaign key visual
pitfalls: Generated lettering may be malformed
text_policy: Use image as typographic direction; set production type externally

use_when: Creating a poetic portrait or concept-led editorial image
pitfalls: Avoid recognizable people without permission and conflicting silhouettes
text_policy: No essential text in image

use_when: Illustrating natural history, ecology, or science stories
pitfalls: Do not fabricate species traits, locations, or research claims
text_policy: Keep scientific labels external and verified

use_when: Producing product listing or commercial hero imagery
pitfalls: Do not alter product attributes or make unverified claims
text_policy: Use final price, claims, and legal copy externally

use_when: Showing a personalized product or service recommendation
pitfalls: Do not expose personal data or imply sensitive inference
text_policy: Use synthetic data and explanatory labels only

use_when: Establishing a logo, palette, and identity direction
pitfalls: Do not imitate protected marks or claim clearance
text_policy: Avoid generated taglines; verify trademark separately

use_when: Applying an approved identity across touchpoints
pitfalls: Do not substitute invented logos for approved assets
text_policy: Apply supplied copy and marks in production tools

use_when: Visualizing an architectural or interior spatial concept
pitfalls: Do not present concept imagery as buildable documentation
text_policy: No regulatory, dimensions, or safety claims in image

use_when: Directing a polished photorealistic image
pitfalls: Avoid real-person likenesses, false events, and deceptive evidence
text_policy: No factual captions embedded

use_when: Depicting an observational, human-centered story moment
pitfalls: Never represent synthetic scenes as documentary evidence
text_policy: Caption as illustration; do not fabricate reportage text

use_when: Defining a reusable editorial illustration system
pitfalls: Avoid living-artist style imitation and inconsistent motifs
text_policy: Keep essential text outside art

use_when: Defining a repeatable character for narrative or IP work
pitfalls: Avoid protected character resemblance and unsafe stereotypes
text_policy: Use labels externally; do not depend on generated callouts

use_when: Visualizing a collectible figure or toy concept
pitfalls: Do not copy known toy brands or make child-safety claims
text_policy: No packaging warnings or commercial copy in image

use_when: Creating a narrative scene with clear action and emotion
pitfalls: Avoid ambiguous action, harmful stereotypes, or false reportage
text_policy: Keep dialogue and captions external

use_when: Creating historical or classical culture visual interpretation
pitfalls: Do not present speculative details as verified history
text_policy: Use sourced dates and labels externally

use_when: Packaging a report, article, or publication visual system
pitfalls: Do not put dense body copy or citations into generated image
text_policy: Typeset title, citations, and accessibility copy externally

use_when: Explaining product research and development stages
pitfalls: Do not reveal confidential plans or claim unverified timelines
text_policy: Use approved short labels and external detailed text
